facts.fact: Orison Legal says the Financial Services Commission made the Financial Services (Robotic and Artificial Intelligence Enabled Advisory Services) Rules in 2021, which apply to licensees providing investment and portfolio management through AI-enabled algorithms.
facts.system: Financial Services (Robotic and Artificial Intelligence Enabled Advisory Services) Rules

facts.fact: Orison Legal says the FSC AI Rules apply only to AI-enabled investment advisory licensees and argues that Mauritius needs a comprehensive AI legislation, so none exists across sectors.
